How it works

01 /

Choose and check your stop

Search in English or Tamil, or choose a point on the map. Check the side of the road before starting.

02 /

Start after you board

Allow location access and keep this page visible. We use your phone, not a live bus feed.

03 /

Listen for your heads-up

The alert uses your approach speed or distance. Road layout and traffic can change the actual arrival time.

About the data & this pilot

Community coverage is incomplete and stop positions may be inaccurate. This app is independent of MTC and TNSTC. Map tiles need internet; loaded stops and the alarm work offline while this page stays active.

Only saved destinations, preferences and your last 20 ride summaries are kept in this browser. GPS coordinates are never sent to our server. Showing map tiles sends the viewed map area to OpenStreetMap.
